title: Synthetic working case definition: acute respiratory illness
licence: SYNTHETIC test data - no real licence
abstract: [SYNTHETIC TEST DOCUMENT] A synthetic working case definition for acute respiratory illness, used only to exercise retrieval and filtering. It is not a real case definition.

excerpts.text: A synthetic suspected case of acute respiratory illness is a person with cough with fever or difficulty breathing of recent onset, reported by a health facility within the surveillance window.
A synthetic cluster is two or more suspected cases that are linked by place and by time.
